meta.title: Manage Line Items: Save fails when price is negative

plan.title: Negative Price in Draft Line Items

steps.note: Open the Events list to reach the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the saved draft's create screen.
Open the Manage Line Items window for the draft.

args.goal: In the Manage Line Items window, select a product, enter 90 in Quantity, enter -100 in the Price field, click Save, and stop when the screen shows that saving the negative price was refused.

steps.note: Perform the line-item edits and Save action that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Assert that Procol reported an error instead of saving the negative price.
